thread:
nina_s: quick sync to lock the "observe-lite" GA slice. need narrow scope so infra can keep costs predictable.

maria_k: customer asks summarized: single-pane route cost, error hotspot map, trace-drill from error row, and a sampling control to mute noisy routes. several pilots asked for 30d but ok to gate.

samir: constraint: full-trace ingest is expensive. propose: trace-link (lookup by trace_id) + sampling presets. also need to fix trace_id passthrough for legacy pipelines.
jordan_p: can we agree on acceptance criteria now? i'm mapping to API + effort.
emily: propose GA acceptance: (1) route cost row with 7d sparkline (2) error heatmap + top-10 endpoints (3) "view trace" action -> opens trace viewer if trace exists (4) sampling presets: low/med/high (1%/5%/20%) (5) PagerDuty webhook MVP (single rule) (6) retention setting visible, default 7d.
maria_k: add rollout/canary: 5 pilot orgs for 48h, monitor median token latency and tail p95 for 72h, require <3% median latency delta.
samir: infra checklist: add sampling flag to routing policy, ensure serializer passes trace_id, circuit-breaker for trace-forwarder errors, surface KV cache hit metric per-route. sampling mustn't invalidate KV.
jordan_p: rough estimates: must-haves = ~3 dev-weeks, PD + retention UI = ~1 dev-week. 30d or full-trace capture = extra 2+ wks.
 nina_s: decision: ship GA with must-haves, default 7d, gate 30d behind Dedicated/Enterprise, use presets. owners: emily mock, samir infra, jordan API, maria comms.

opsbot: deploybot: feature gate created: feature=observe-lite, env=staging, owners=[samir,jordan_p]

emily: mock shared (internal): https://mockup.redwood/in/obs-lite-01 — will iterate.

nina_s: thanks all. reconvene after mocks + infra doc in 48h. ping me for blockers. :rocket:
